title: Intelligent Automation Engineer
description: Our CompanyBrightSpring Health ServicesOverviewBrightSpring Health Services is a Louisville‑headquartered leader in complementary home‑ and community‑based health services for complex populations, with integrated clinical and pharmacy solutions across care settings. Following its combination with PharMerica, BrightSpring operates a diversified care and pharmacy platform—serving patients and provider partners nationwide—which makes intelligent automation a pivotal enabler of clinical, operational, corporate, and pharmacy outcomes at scale.We’re seeking an Intelligent Automation Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot Studio, and Agentic AI. This role will design scalable solutions, drive delivery from concept through production, conduct code reviews, support production deployments, and collaborate with business, technology, security, data, and operations teams to deliver measurable outcomes.Responsibilities What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) Solution Design & Engineering Design secure, scalable, and maintainable intelligent automation solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, business requirements, and operational standards. Translate business needs into solution designs, technical specifications, process flows, reusable components, and implementation plans. Evaluate automation opportunities and recommend the appropriate combination of UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Copilot Studio, APIs, and Agentic AI. Delivery & Architecture Develop and configure enterprise automations using UiPath, including Studio, Orchestrator, queues, assets, reusable libraries, Document Understanding, and attended and unattended automation patterns. Build business solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, and Copilot Studio, integrating Microsoft 365, Azure, enterprise applications, databases, and APIs. Apply Agentic AI patterns, including tool use, task orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls, prompt design, grounding, evaluation, and guardrails. Drive assigned solutions through design, development, testing, user acceptance, release readiness, and successful production deployment. Create resilient solutions with structured logging, exception handling, retry logic, credential security, auditability, monitoring, and operational support documentation. Quality, Governance & Production Readiness Conduct peer code reviews and design reviews to ensure quality, security, maintainability, performance, and adherence to development standards. Prepare and execute production deployments in accordance with change management, access governance, testing, rollback, and release-control requirements. Monitor production solutions, troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive improvements. Collaboration & Delivery Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, developers, infrastructure, security, data, and support teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. Communicate technical options, dependencies, risks, and delivery status clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Contribute to estimation, sprint planning, documentation, knowledge transfer, production support, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting enterprise automation solutions. Advanced proficiency with UiPath, including Studio, Orchestrator, queues, assets, libraries, integrations, and production operations. Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps. Experience creating actionable dashboards, operational reporting, and analytics solutions with Power BI. Hands-on experience building copilots, conversational workflows, or enterprise assistants with Copilot Studio. Working knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, prompt engineering, grounding, safety controls, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop patterns. Demonstrated ability to perform code reviews, follow SDLC and DevOps practices, and execute controlled production deployments. Strong understanding of APIs, web services, databases, source control, secure credential management, exception handling, and monitoring. Excellent problem-solving, communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience delivering intelligent automation solutions in healthcare, pharmacy, revenue cycle, clinical, or other regulated environments. Experience with Azure services, AI services, Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise integration patterns. Knowledge of process mining, task mining, intelligent document processing, OCR, and automation opportunity assessment. Experience designing reusable frameworks, self-healing automations, operational dashboards, and support-ready solutions. Relevant certifications such as UiPath Advanced RPA Developer, UiPath Solution Architect, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Azure AI, or Copilot Studio. Familiarity with Agile delivery, backlog management, estimation, testing, release management, and production support practices. Ability to mentor peers, share reusable practices, and contribute to intelligent automation standards and governance. About Our Line Of BusinessBrightSpring Health Services provides complementary home- and community-based health solutions for medically complex populations in need of specialized and/or chronic care. Through the Company’s service lines, including pharmacy, home health care, and rehabilitation, we provide comprehensive and more integrated care and clinical solutions in all 50 states to approximately 500,000 customers, clients and patients daily. BrightSpring has consistently demonstrated strong and industry-leading quality metrics across its services lines, while improving the health and quality of life for high-need individuals and reducing overall healthcare system costs. title: Toptal: ML Inference Engineer – Terminal-Bench Task Designer
description: Headquarters: Overview We are building a benchmark that tests how well AI agents handle real expert work in a terminal. We are hiring ML inference and serving experts to turn real, paid tasks from their jobs into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the environment, a working solution, and an automated check that proves the result is correct. ***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.*** Responsibilities • Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks that turn real, paid ML inference work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end. • Define the files, systems and environments each task runs on, such as model serving with streaming, so the challenge is realistic, reproducible and command-line solvable. • Write a working reference solution for every task and verify it runs end to end, sized for about 60 to 75 minutes of expert effort. • Build automated checks that objectively prove a result is correct, including cases where ML outputs go wrong silently, such as numerical drift or metric bugs. • Package tasks with Docker and Git so they are reproducible, and document the systems, tools, data and rules involved so reviewers can validate difficulty. • Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback and agent test runs, adjusting difficulty and fixing ambiguities so each task stays expert-level, fair and objectively gradable. Skills/Experience • 3+ years doing ML inference or serving work hands-on (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD plus active research in the subfield • Did this work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used • Trained, served or evaluated models at real scale (multi-GPU or production serving), not only notebooks or API calls • Hands-on with PyTorch or JAX internals and serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM • Can explain how ML results go wrong without errors (numerical drift, metric bugs) and how to catch them • Technical fluency in Python and the command line, and with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases • Availability to start by early November 2026 and complete tasks of about 60 to 75 minutes each Nice-to-have • AI lab or LLM infrastructure experience • Contributions to PyTorch, vLLM or SGLang • GPU profiling experience • Docker and Git proficiency • Experience writing automated tests Process • Task vetting instead of an interview: complete a vetting task so the client can assess your task design • Paid per task; each task takes about 60 to 75 minutes • Work is delivered task by task, with reviewer feedback on submissions • Expected start in early November 2026 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-ml-inference-engineer-terminal-bench-task-designer
